description: Create a Pinterest product CATALOG (RETAIL for products, or HOTEL) — the container feeds and items fill. Read back from Pinterest. Most merchants can skip it: a feed created without catalogId lands in a default retail catalog. 0 credits.

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

adAccountId.description: optional — act as this ad account’s owner via Pinterest Business Access (must be shared with this profile)

name: create_pinterest_catalog
title: Create a Pinterest catalog
